landing_headline: Sittuyin on a hand-rubbed teak board
landing_description: Play authentic Myanmar Sittuyin on an uncheckered 8x8 teak board with inlaid sit ke myin promotion diagonals, hidden simultaneous setup, and carved Burmese wooden pieces.
landing_pieces_subheading: Vermilion lacquer & burnished gold Red pieces against smoked ebony & antique ivory Black pieces
landing_feature_setup_body: Arrange your 8 officers privately with drag, swap, random setup, or 5 classic Myanmar opening formations.
landing_feature_sitkemyin_body: When you have no General on the board, promote an eligible pawn in place or 1 square diagonally into a Sit ke.
landing_feature_replay_body: Study every ply in Myanmar or English notation and paste any Sittuyin FEN + UCI sequence to scrub move by move.
copied_uci_toast: Copied UCI move list to clipboard
setup_subtitle: Place all 8 officers inside your zone. Chariots (Rooks) must be placed on the back rank.
setup_locked_notice: Formation locked. Click Unlock if you want to adjust pieces.
setup_drag_hint: Tap or drag officers onto glowing squares. Drag off-board or double-tap to remove.
handoff_description: {fromSide} has locked in their formation. Hand the device to {toSide} before revealing the board.
promote_description: Choose whether to promote in place or step 1 square diagonally.
history_empty: No moves played yet. Complete setup to begin the match.
scrubber_readonly_banner: Inspecting an earlier ply. Return to live to play moves.
replay_page_subtitle: Paste an initial Sittuyin FEN and UCI moves to inspect every ply.
prefs_description: Saved locally in this browser for your table.
prefs_script_overlay: Burmese script badges on pieces (မ, စ, ရ, ဆ, မြ, န)
prefs_sit_ke_myin: Highlight sit ke myin promotion diagonals
err_INVALID_PHASE: That action is not allowed in the current match phase.
err_INVALID_SETUP_MODE: This setup action requires hidden simultaneous setup mode.
err_SIDE_ALREADY_LOCKED: Your formation is locked. Unlock first to make changes.
err_SQUARE_OCCUPIED: That square already has an officer placed on it.
err_SQUARE_EMPTY: There is no drafted officer on that square.
err_ROOK_MUST_BE_BACK_RANK: Chariots (Rooks) must be placed on your back rank.
err_OUTSIDE_SETUP_ZONE: That square is outside your legal setup zone.
err_PIECE_NOT_IN_HAND: No remaining officers of that type in your tray.
err_SETUP_INCOMPLETE: Place all 8 officers before locking your formation.
err_WRONG_TURN: It is not that side's turn to move.
err_PROMOTION_NOT_ALLOWED: General promotion is not allowed here.
err_ILLEGAL_STALEMATE: Delivering stalemate is illegal under Myanmar Sittuyin rules.
err_INVALID_PIECE_COUNT: Piece counts exceed traditional Sittuyin limits.
err_OPPONENT_IN_CHECK: Invalid position: the opponent King cannot start in check.
err_REPLAY_MOVE_FAILED: A move in the replay sequence could not be applied.
online_page_subtitle: Join an open challenge, create a private 6-character invite room, or spectate live games.
online_open_challenges_empty: No open challenges right now. Create a room to invite an opponent.
online_live_matches_empty: No active matches in progress right now.
create_room_subtitle: Configure a public lobby challenge or a private room with a 6-character invite code.
create_room_mode_public_desc: Listed in Open Challenges for anyone to join.
create_room_mode_private_desc: Hidden from the lobby; join via 6-character code or link.
waiting_overlay_subtitle: The 60-second hidden setup phase begins automatically as soon as your opponent joins.
waiting_copied_link_toast: Copied room invite link to clipboard
online_draw_offer_pending_mine: Draw offer sent — awaiting opponent response
online_opponent_disconnected: {side} disconnected — waiting up to 60s to reconnect
online_spectator_setup_desc: Both players are privately arranging their 8 officers. The full board will be revealed when both lock in or the 60s countdown ends.
outcome_aborted_maintenance: Match aborted due to scheduled server maintenance
room_connecting_desc: Verifying match ticket and synchronizing authoritative board state.
room_err_conflict_desc: You are already seated as a player in another active match. Finish or leave that match before joining a new table.
room_err_timeout_desc: No opponent joined within the waiting window, so the table was closed.
room_err_aborted_desc: The host closed this waiting table before the match began.
room_err_maintenance_desc: The game server is briefly paused for maintenance. Please try again shortly.
room_err_not_found_desc: Check that the 6-character invite code is correct or pick an open challenge from the lobby.
err_FORBIDDEN_SPECTATOR: Spectators cannot modify the board or match state.
err_DRAW_ALREADY_PENDING: A draw offer is already pending.
err_DRAW_COOLDOWN_ACTIVE: You may offer a draw at most once per turn cycle.
err_NO_DRAW_OFFER_PENDING: There is no pending draw offer from your opponent.
err_ABORT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Matches can only be aborted before Black completes move 1.
err_NO_REMATCH_PENDING: There is no pending rematch offer from your opponent.
err_SERVER_MAINTENANCE: The server is locked for scheduled maintenance.
account_provisional_hint: Provisional rating (fewer than 10 games or high RD)
create_room_private_unrated_desc: Private invite rooms are always unrated.
leaderboard_subtitle: Established rated players ranked by Glicko-2 rating (10+ rated games and RD ≤ 110).
leaderboard_empty_desc: Play 10 rated public lobby matches with a stabilized rating deviation (RD ≤ 110) to claim the top spot.
leaderboard_your_rank_provisional_games: Play {games} more rated games to qualify for the leaderboard.
leaderboard_your_rank_provisional_rd: Keep playing rated matches to lower your rating deviation below 110.
leaderboard_your_rank_provisional_both: Play {games} more rated games and lower your RD below 110 to qualify.
profile_match_history_owner_note: Includes your private room games (only visible to you).
profile_match_history_empty_desc: Completed online matches will appear here with full interactive replays.
profile_not_found_desc: We could not find a player with handle @{handle}. They may have changed their handle or never existed.
match_replay_not_found_desc: This match link may be invalid, or the game may still be saving right after finishing.
